annotations.title: Push a page's content to Bing

description: SubmitContent: pushes a page's full content (a base64-encoded HTTP message) directly to Bing for a project's matched site, bypassing a crawl. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION — unlike get_bing_site_overview, it queues real work on the operator's live Bing Webmaster account. Bring-your-own-key: requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account.

dynamicServing.description: Optional dynamic-serving indicator Bing accepts alongside the content.

httpMessage.description: The page's full HTTP response, already base64-encoded by the caller — this tool does not encode it.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

structuredData.description: Optional structured-data payload Bing accepts alongside the content.

url.description: Absolute URL of the page being submitted.

name: submit_bing_content
